title: Juche

symbol.name: Juche
symbol.meaning: Self-reliance; the diagram is Mount Baekdu · ITF pattern 15 of 24

note.p: Juche is the idea that people are masters of everything and decide everything, masters of the world and of their own destiny. The diagram, 山, stands for Mount Baekdu. Choi Jung Hwa's ITF teaches the same 45 movements under the name Kodang, after the patriot Cho Man-sik; its 45 movements stand for 1945, the year Korea was freed. You start in parallel stance with twin side elbow facing D: parallel blocks and a hooking block in sitting stance; side and reverse hooking kicks from a one-leg stance; a jump into X-stance with a back fist; hooking and side kicks, a fingertip cross-cut and a high elbow strike; a reverse knife-hand block and a spinning mid-air knife-hand strike; the same to the other side; a pick-shape kick; then straight elbow thrusts, arc-hand strikes, dodging hooking kicks, a flying two-direction kick, a back kick and a flying punch along the C–D line.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (45 movements; double kicks, kick-and-block and the flying punches are split into -1 and -2 here). The pattern goes out to both ends of the line through the start and along both legs of the diagram, then back and forth on the C–D line, so the board shows the moves in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the two short legs, which run toward C from the A and B ends, and AE and BF the diagonals between. Finish by bringing the right foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand on the start facing D in parallel stance with twin side elbow: feet parallel, fists in front of the chest, elbows out.
Move the left foot to B into a sitting stance facing D. Inner forearm parallel block.
Stand up, facing D. Right palm middle hooking block.
Sink back into the sitting stance. Left middle punch toward D.
Pull the right reverse footsword up to the left knee joint into a left one-leg stance facing D. Outer forearm parallel block.
Right middle side piercing kick toward A, slowly, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, right high reverse hooking kick toward B, slowly.
Land the right foot toward B with a jump, into a right X-stance facing F. Right back fist downward strike toward B.
Left middle hooking kick toward F, both fists drawn in front of the chest.
Without setting the foot down, left high side piercing kick toward F.
Stamp the left foot down toward F into a sitting stance facing B. Left flat fingertip high outward cross-cut toward F.
Turn into a left walking stance facing BF. Right high elbow strike, the left palm pressing the right side fist.
Cross the left foot over the right foot into a right X-stance facing B. Left reverse knife-hand low front block, the right fingertips on the left forearm.
Move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Jump and spin counter-clockwise, striking toward A in mid-air with the left knife-hand; land toward A in a right L-stance (left foot forward), the left arm extended.
Move the right foot to A into a sitting stance facing D. Inner forearm parallel block.
Stand up, facing D. Left palm middle hooking block.
Sink back into the sitting stance. Right middle punch toward D.
Pull the left reverse footsword up to the right knee joint into a right one-leg stance facing D. Outer forearm parallel block.
Left middle side piercing kick toward B, slowly, the hands held where they were.
Without setting the foot down, left high reverse hooking kick toward A, slowly.
Land the left foot toward A with a jump, into a left X-stance facing E. Left back fist downward strike toward A.
Right middle hooking kick toward E, both fists drawn in front of the chest.
Without setting the foot down, right high side piercing kick toward E.
Stamp the right foot down toward E into a sitting stance facing A. Right flat fingertip high outward cross-cut toward E.
Turn into a right walking stance facing AE. Left high elbow strike, the right palm pressing the left side fist.
Cross the right foot over the left foot into a left X-stance facing A. Right reverse knife-hand low front block, the left fingertips on the right forearm.
Move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Jump and spin clockwise, striking toward B in mid-air with the right knife-hand; land toward B in a left L-stance (right foot forward), the right arm extended.
Left pick-shape kick toward B.
Lower the left foot toward B into a right rear foot stance facing B (left foot forward on its ball). Forearm middle guarding block.
Bring the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing D, raising a heaven hand, slowly.
Slide back toward C into a left rear foot stance facing D (right foot forward on its ball). Right straight elbow downward thrust.
Slip the right foot forward into a right walking stance facing D. Left arc-hand high crescent strike.
Slide back toward C into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Left straight elbow downward thrust.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance facing D. Right arc-hand high crescent strike.
Move the left foot back to C into a right walking stance facing D. Twin knife-hand high inward strike.
Move the right foot back to C into a left walking stance facing D. Right downward punch.
Move the left foot to the side rear of the right foot, then slide toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left outer forearm downward block.
Jump back away from D: right dodging reverse hooking kick toward D.
Land toward C in a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Move the right foot to the side rear of the left foot, then slide toward C into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right outer forearm downward block.
Jump back away from D: left dodging reverse hooking kick toward D.
Land toward C in a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Step the right foot, then the left foot toward D and fly: flying two-direction kick, a left twisting kick and a right side piercing kick.
Land toward D in a left diagonal stance facing D. Twin palm rising block.
Slide toward D into a right rear foot stance facing C (left foot forward on its ball). Right side elbow thrust toward D.
Turn the face to D, drawing the left foot up into a right bending ready stance B facing C, slowly.
Left middle back piercing kick toward D, slowly.
Stamp the left foot down toward D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left back fist horizontal strike.
Pull the right foot up into a parallel stance facing D. Right flat fingertip high inward cross-cut.
Fly forward toward D: right front punch in the air.
Still in the air, right upset punch; land toward D in a closed stance, the right fist extended.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Left knife-hand front downward strike.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. Right middle punch.
